cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1956; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6247, lot no. 86, 5 December 1991 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: In pencil, by O'Keeffe, 'Blue Morning Glory 36'" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: O'Keeffe initials and star" [not verified]. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription date 1936. Dated 1935/1936 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription, 1937 exhibition checklist.
titles.title: Blue Morning Glory

description: A blue morning glory with a yellow center sits in a reflective, circular vase. The vase rests on a gray surface against a white background.
